claim: Patchline ships a hosted public good service analyzing open-source PRs for free with transparent cost reporting. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the transparent cost claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make hosted-public-good-service-gate`.
